report.text:
WIN-GES-T4-20261009 completion report (goldfish-deep, claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh; ruleset 0.7.0+claude.20261008194106.da20519d; candidate c7abe2c1a; commit 648046bfb).
Route pre-check (subject class S): requested claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh; observed identity "claude-sonnet-5-5" from this dispatch's runtime prompt; no contradiction.
Status: implementation complete, test-only commit made. Independent review: pending (Elephant dispatches the Critic; no receipt supplied). Not PO-accepted.

1. DoD results
- Native before/after captures (before.txt, after.txt): passed (both written). before: 59 tests, 50 pass, 1 fail, 8 skipped. after: 61 tests, 53 pass, 1 fail, 7 skipped.
- Formerly skipped cases RUN and are green in after.txt: "actual sanctioned v2 mint and pure observer share stable identity without writes" and "linked worktree observes same common identity; bare repository remains unsupported" (both were POSIX-MODE-UNHONOURED product-fault skips in before.txt). passed.
- Refusal cases on hardened fixtures green in after.txt (legacy v1, closed-validation drift, multiple links, oversized), plus the new WIN-GES-T4 DACL pin. passed.
- Remaining red, named: the restricted-storage case at test line ~1138 (title "restricted storage stays outside the repository, is owner-only encrypted, and supports exact active-store erasure"), identical in before.txt and after.txt: GES-RESTRICTED-PERMISSIONS "Restricted records must not grant group or other access", thrown from restrictedRecordsRoot (governance-event-store.mjs:272) via putRestrictedGovernanceEvent (:1730). State at capture: HEAD already contains 5a72c9b61 (WIN-HARDEN-F, "persist only the access section so hardening stays idempotent"), and the case is still red, with a different code than Ruling 143 named (that ruling named GES-RESTRICTED-WINDOWS-ASSURANCE). Not diagnosed, not edited, not mine.
- WSL after run (wsl-after.txt): exit 0 (green). I did not extract test counts from it (budget); only the exit code is evidenced.
- check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: passed, 9/9, exit 0.
- Commit of the test file with the briefed subject: passed (see section 2).

2. Evidence
- evidence/WIN-GES-T4-20261009/before.txt, after.txt, wsl-after.txt, each written by node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs (native: node --test plugins/pipeline-core/lib/governance-event-store.test.mjs, wrapped exit 1 for both, the sole failure being the unrelated restricted-storage case; WSL: same via wsl.exe -e bash -lc, wrapped exit 0).
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs, exit 0.
- Commit 648046bfb: test(governance-event-store): run the existing-binding cases on win32 and make their refusals discriminate. Message in scratch/commit-msg/WIN-GES-T4-20261009.txt (trailers AI-Assisted and Dispatch only).

3. Changed files
- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/governance-event-store.test.mjs: fixture hardens its binding directory with hardenWindowsPrivateDirectory on win32 and asserts directory/file assess as secure (self-classifying red); two product-fault skips lifted and the now-dead skip constant removed; legacy, drift, links and oversized cases each prove a hardened binding accepted, apply one in-place mutation, and for links also prove acceptance returns when the mutation is undone; the former combined links/writable case is split; new WIN-GES-T4 DACL pin. The WIN-GES-T3 pin is byte-identical.
- Uncommitted, untracked by design: evidence/WIN-GES-T4-20261009/*.txt, evidence/dispatch-record-WIN-GES-T4-20261009.json (for the dispatcher to commit).

4. Deliberately not changed
- The :1138 restricted-storage case, windows-private-state.mjs, governance-event-store.mjs (read only).
- The symlink-alias case body, the missing-identity case, the WIN-GES-T3 pin: untouched (the symlink and missing cases now get a hardened fixture through the shared helper, which only adds a win32 precondition).
- Not mutation-tested: discrimination is by construction (control accepted, one mutation, DACL precondition), I did not break the production predicates to watch each case turn red.

5. Deviations from spec
- "Writable binding" cannot discriminate on win32 (no POSIX mode): it is now its own case with a typed POSIX-MODE-UNHONOURED skip naming the equivalent. The equivalent pin compares identical bytes in a hardened and an unhardened os.tmpdir() directory and asserts the assessor does not call the latter secure. Its limit: it proves "DACL not private", not specifically "a DACL granting a non-owner write"; no hardener fixture produces that ACE without a hand-built ACL, so I did not build one.
- Reading source (governance-event-store.mjs:910-918): the size and link-count predicates sit in validFile, before the DACL assessment, so on win32 the old oversized and links assertions already refused at their own predicate; legacy v1 and drift refused at the DACL assessment before the schema check. All four now carry a control, so the briefing's "probably refuse at the DACL assessment" holds for legacy/drift only. Read from source, not probed.
- The first WSL attempt (capture-evidence wrapping wsl.exe -e bash -lc directly) was refused by GUARD-DEVPLAN-SHELL with no retry action; the working spelling puts the cd and capture-evidence inside the bash -lc string.

6. Open items
- independent review: pending; PO acceptance pending.
- :1138 restricted-storage red remains and is outside this slice; its code differs from Ruling 143's description, which the Elephant may want to record.
- The record's log has one gap between entries 12 and 33; the finalizer wrote the rest.
- Tool uses: about 45 of 45 base; the closing allowance was used for the record write only. Not a closing-allowance handover: the work is complete.
